title: surveyIDmasker: Mask participant identifiers in survey exports
description: R package that replaces participant identifiers in survey exports (Prolific, CloudResearch Connect and MTurk IDs, IP addresses, locations, emails) with codes made by encrypting each value with a private key. Repeated participants remain recognizable, and the authors, who keep the key, can turn the codes back into the original identifiers. Reads and writes the CSV, SPSS and Excel files exported by Qualtrics.
